```python
def _get_single_child(name: str, statistics: Dict[str, Dict[str, str]]
    ) ->Optional[str]:
    prefix = name + ("." if name else "")
    children = []
    for mod_name in statistics:
        if mod_name and mod_name.startswith(prefix) and mod_name.count(".") == prefix.count("."):
            children.append(mod_name)
    if len(children) == 1:
        return children[0]
    return None
```
